name: Sam Sloan
life: “I still remember missing my stop on my first morning as a planner.” Friday often includes a stop at Studio Boulevard, where Sam waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: I made the map but left out the bakery because it wasn't a registered depot.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a striped cotton shirt and a partly rubbed-away embroidered initial. Sam has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Sam touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word during a conversation.
personality: Sam can be wonderfully decisive about an emergency and maddeningly undecided about a gift. This is because a person can say precisely what hurts and rarely says exactly what they want.
agenda: To put the unofficial depot on the delivery route.
family: Rae Meyer is Sam’s parent’s cousin. Sam chooses whether to use it. Rae saves a place. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *Saturday keys*, Rae says, “I want one key back permanently. Opening my own door is the part of Saturday I look forward to.”
connections: Elise Cotton (notice printer). They redesign the printed diversion around the users it left out.

reactions.situation: A delivery customer refuses the late parcel
reactions.response: Sam checks with the intended recipient before leaving a late parcel.

reactions.situation: A frightened child is waiting outside a shuttered shop
reactions.response: Sam stays where the child can see the shop door and asks the neighboring counter to help find the adult expected there.

reactions.situation: If a neighbor offers a costly present
reactions.response: Sam asks for an afternoon to work out whether accepting it would put someone else in debt.
